title: Bauernfristuck with Garlicky Steak
description: A traditional German-style flank steak dish, marinated in a garlicky mixture and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic and olive oil.
Rub the garlic-olive oil mixture all over the flank steak, making sure to coat it evenly.
Season the steak with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the steak on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the bauernfristuck with your choice of sides, such as sautéed vegetables or a salad.
